answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the shale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the gale of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
